title: Bounded FMC simultaneous surface-infiltration plus fixed-water-table composition comparator
purpose: Test whether the independently retained D13 groundwater-front and D16 surface-infiltration branches remain jointly mass-conservative and hydrologically competitive with R2 when they operate simultaneously in one B01 column, without introducing falling-slug/groundwater merge semantics into the first composition experiment.

predecessor_authority.D12: FMC/SMVE equation authority; 200 moisture bins and <=10 s explicit process step frozen.
predecessor_authority.D13: FMC_GW200 fixed-water-table groundwater-front branch retained research candidacy versus R2.
predecessor_authority.D15: Finite-volume atmospheric accounting and slug-groundwater union primitive qualified before trajectory exposure.
predecessor_authority.D16: FMC surface infiltration/hiatus branch retained bounded research candidacy versus R2.
predecessor_authority.implication: D17 composes existing equations/accounting only; it does not alter bin count, process step, front laws, capillary relaxation, Green-Ampt rules or finite-volume bookkeeping.

retained: finite water-content domain permits simultaneous land-surface infiltration fronts and groundwater fronts
left-most bins may be in contact with both land surface and groundwater
surface water first satisfies K(theta_i)*dt demand of bins in contact with groundwater before advancing infiltration fronts
falling-slug/groundwater merge exists but is outside D17
surface-flux plus groundwater-table interaction is within the FMC method envelope

surface_component.connected_fronts: linear in j from z_101=120 cm to z_199=10 cm

groundwater_component.groundwater_front_height: H_j=0.25*abs(psi(theta_j)) above fixed water table at z=160 cm

initial_composite_state.baseline: theta_i = theta_r + 100*dtheta across the full column
initial_composite_state.occupancy: for every active bin j, surface water occupies [0,z_j] and groundwater-connected water occupies [160-H_j,160]
initial_composite_state.required_preflight_separation: z_j + H_j < 160 cm for every j at t=0 and after every D17 process step; any contact closes D17 before or during FMC preflight because D17 intentionally excludes contact/merge semantics
initial_composite_state.exact_cell_mapping: R16/R2 initial theta is the exact finite-volume cell average of baseline plus disjoint surface and groundwater occupied intervals, followed by inverse B01 retention for pressure head

top.duration: 16 x 10 s with no hiatus in D17

bottom.SWAP: bottom mode 5, prescribed bottom pressure head 0 cm
bottom.FMC: fixed water table at column bottom z=160 cm using D13 groundwater-front equations

per_10s_step: reserve gray-bin throughflow demand K(theta_i)*dt from surface supply; require supply >= this demand
count that gray-bin demand as direct downward bottom exchange through the bins already in contact with both surface and groundwater
allocate all remaining surface supply to the already active D16 connected fronts using Eq.18 and D15 left-to-right finite-volume accounting; no dry-bin activation
apply D14 conservative capillary relaxation to connected-front ordering
advance D13 groundwater fronts for the same 10 s by Eq.21 forward Euler and apply D13 conservative capillary relaxation
compute groundwater-front storage change; its negative is groundwater-front bottom-outward exchange as in D13
total bottom-outward exchange = gray-bin direct throughflow - groundwater-front storage change
require all surface and groundwater occupied intervals remain disjoint; no falling slug, surface-groundwater contact, or merge occurs in D17
global ledger: delta column storage - top_infiltration + bottom_outward_exchange = 0 within 1e-12 cm
FMC_composition_algorithm.top_flux_groundwater_interaction_boundar: D17 tests the published simultaneous gray-bin throughflow plus independent active surface/GW-front evolution only. It does not qualify the later falling-slug-to-groundwater merge route.

checks: initial D16-I_DEEP plus D13-G25 occupied intervals are disjoint for every active bin
initial composite finite-volume storage maps exactly to R16/R2 cell averages within 1e-12 cm
for all four histories every step has top supply >= K(theta_i)*dt gray-bin demand
remaining surface supply is fully absorbed by existing connected fronts with no dry-bin activation, ponding or runoff
D13 groundwater fronts remain finite, physical and monotone after relaxation
surface and groundwater intervals remain strictly separated for all 16 steps
surface relaxation and groundwater relaxation each conserve their finite-volume increments
global composite mass ledger closes to <=1e-12 cm per step
internal_preflight_before_SWAP_trajector.failure_rule: Any failure closes D17 before R16/R2 trajectory generation. Do not retune top factors, duration, lambda, initial surface profile, bin count, process step or branch equations inside D17.

SWAP_comparators.numerical_authority: D4 strict-first integrated-water-depth research policy with hard accepted-transaction mass gate 1e-12 cm; no production tolerance change
SWAP_comparators.initialization: exact cell-average mapping of the frozen composite FMC initial state
SWAP_comparators.top_boundary: same prescribed downward flux as FMC

positive_rule: internal preflight passes before SWAP trajectory exposure
all four FMC/R16/R2 histories complete with integrity
balance view: FMC total-storage RMSE <= R2 and FMC cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE <= R2
profile view: FMC mapped 16-cell theta RMSE <= R2
groundwater-flux view: FMC terminal bottom-flux RMSE <= R2 and FMC sign-error count <= R2

successor_logic.if_positive: Retain FMC as a broader hydraulic research candidate and preregister a separate D18 contact/merge experiment or purpose-specific longer-horizon validation before any runtime frontier or application claim.
successor_logic.if_negative: Do not retune D12-D16 bins/substeps/front laws. Diagnose which composed view fails and restrict FMC candidacy accordingly.
successor_logic.if_preflight_contact_occurs: Close D17 before SWAP exposure; any slug/contact/merge experiment requires a new work-unit with its own primary-source-bound transition semantics.
